criterion_fired: CRITERION 3 (Decision Criteria evidence quality) and CRITERION 4 (actionable next steps)
suggested_change: CRITERION 3: Require explicit resolution statement: 'If ambiguity exists between customer requirement and vendor limitation, classify as validation need (not disqualifier) and state which party owns confirmation.' CRITERION 4: Define actionable as containing subject + verb + timeline, e.g. 'Schedule call with [name] by [date] to ask [question]' rather than 'Confirm by end of week'.
